subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Flexible
solution:
The correct answer is __**Defiant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Antonym means a phrase or word with the opposite meaning as another phrase or word.
 
• The word **Flexible** means that can be changed easily or that agrees with anything.
 
• The word **Defiant** means openly refusing to obey something or somebody.
 
• The *meaning of word flexible is opposite of the meaning of word Defiant*.
 
• Hence, **option 2 i.e. Defiant** is the answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **"compliant" **refers **to a person or thing that is willing to follow rules or orders, or conform to a standard or regulation.** It can also mean that someone is agreeable or submissive in nature.

 
 
• Example: "The company's products are **compliant **with all relevant safety regulations."
 
 
 
• The word **Peculiar** means unusual or strange.
 
 
• Example : I was in a very **peculiar **situation today.
 
 
 
• The word **Reckless** means not considering the negative or dangerous consequences of your actions
 
 
• Example : He is the most **reckless **person I have ever met.
